recommendation: Keep the no-change audit for FHIR-20641. If FHIR-51598 is later applied, handle that as a separate wording clarification rather than changing this stacked-modifier decision.
issue_request: FHIR-20641 requested allowing :missing to stack with modifiers such as reference type, token :text, and token :of-type. The Published/Not Persuasive with Modification resolution rejected broad stacked-modifier semantics, clarified that stacked modifiers are prohibited, and advised explicit search operations or declared behavior when multiple layers of modification are needed.
initial_application: Commit 1e3b7571675379e59420a5ceaba188bd20bb1012 applied FHIR-20641 by adding the active source/search.html guidance for new search parameters or operations when layered behavior is needed. Related commit fd19eba3ff735b49eb917ed3b722ce8511f8011f for FHIR-37373 added the explicit single-modifier sentence.
additional_context: The motivating Zulip thread discussed reference:type:missing and broader :missing stacking and aligned with custom search parameters rather than stacked modifiers. FHIR-I minutes from 2022-05-23 confirm that related FHIR-37373 was resolved by pointing to FHIR-20641 because modifier chaining is prohibited; FHIR-37373 already has a combined-branch audit commit. Later FHIR-51598 is a separate Resolved - change required wording clarification around chaining before versus after :identifier, not a reversal of FHIR-20641.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source/search.html Search narrative states that only one modifier is allowed on a single search parameter and that layered behavior should be modeled by a new search parameter or operation; the :missing section defines only single-modifier true/false behavior.
